newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs unharmed by new Belgian scandal, Bfr bit off.
newsitem.headline: OLOs unharmed by new Belgian scandal, Bfr bit off.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds opened firmer on Monday, ignoring a new political scandal, but the franc was slightly weaker.
"As political scandals go in Belgium, this is small fry," one Luxembourg-based trader said.

On Friday, a Liege court confirmed the judge in charge of an investigation into alleged political bribes paid by French firm Dassault had arrested two officials of the francophone socialist party (PS). But analysts saw little chance the new twist in the long-running Dassault saga would do any damage to the reigning centre-left coalition.
